name: The recall memory, progress hidden (A, B, A, B): Brain.compose(..., recall=True) at the founder genes against the founder with it off
credit: Will Glynn, cadence-teachers EXP-56, EXP-57, EXP-59 and EXP-60 (https://github.com/WGlynn/cadence-teachers): the chain seen three ways after the ambiguous chain Huncho reported on the Stone Age world, the hold rule, the reading in sequence, the boundary of the rule; the consecutive-alias topology is Huncho's Stone Age V7.4 (https://github.com/ali12mahmood12345-boop/cadence-stone-age/blob/main/docs/V7_RESULTS.md)
question: With Brain.compose(7, 5, modules=(48, 24), arousal=True, memory_choice=True): do the place and ctx5 arms of the context-key screen keep their sampled success and clean greedy passes when the recall memory is added (recall=True at the founder genes), and on which views does the memory raise them?
scope: component witness of the recall memory in a world: V5's four-stage chain seen four ways, two screen founders, the brain, chamber, signals and readings of the context-key screen; a witness, not a gate of the library branch

world.note: A, B, A, B: the ambiguous chain Huncho reported on the Stone Age world, as cadence-teachers EXP-56 and EXP-57 rebuilt it; the two A and the two B observations are byte-identical, so only the stream's history tells stage 3 from stage 1

founder.note: Brain.compose(7, 5, modules=(48, 24), arousal=True, memory_choice=True): the context-key screen's sensory recipe with the recall memory off (recall=False, byte-identical to the brain before the option)

recall.note: the same plus recall=True at the founder genes (the library's defaults, written out; their checkpoint digest equals the defaults'): a recall and a next region of 7 neurons each, addressed by the observation heard before each settle, written after each act, the stream's slots emptied at an episode's end and by Brain.reset; the founder's wiring and initial weights, plus the two regions' projections at scale 1.2

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: natural: none; corrective: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window (V5's corrective teacher)

evaluation.note: a frozen copy read at the arm's seam under its own rule, Brain.reset before each episode (the recall slots emptied, the address map kept): 100 sampled episodes, the reading in sequence (first try per stage, retries), and one greedy episode (a clean pass: four stages in four decisions)

seeds.note: the context-key screen's declared control subset (its 48 founders are 202001 to 202048); both recipes on each

analysis.unit: founder and signal; a pair is one arm on one founder under one signal, recall recipe against founder recipe
analysis.pairs_per_view: two founders x two signals x two arm kinds: 8 pairs per view, 4 per arm kind
analysis.readings: per view, recipe, arm and founder: sampled success (100 episodes) and the clean greedy pass (one greedy episode, four stages in four decisions); first-try accuracy per stage beside them
analysis.preservation: per view, recall minus founder in sampled success, the paired mean over the 8 pairs, at or above -.05; the memory preserves the screen when every view meets it; the same difference per arm kind (4 pairs) and the clean passes as counts with their discordant pairs are reported beside it
analysis.benefit: views where the paired mean difference in sampled success is above zero, with the sign count; hidden and invisible are the views where the stream's history has to tell a stage, visible the view where the observation alone does, consecutive the view where only the brain's own actions do
analysis.report: paired means with their SEM over the 8 pairs and per arm kind over 4; no interval is claimed on two founders; each recipe's place against ctx5 as the screen reported it
analysis.control_check: the founder recipe's readings, trained-state digests and event digests on these founders must equal the dense founder's earlier control runs (the sparse reading's sk-control-<view>, sensory recipe, library c231f5c) arm for arm; a difference is reported, not repaired

derived_from.note: written by recall_screen.py derive; the master declares all four views
